| colspan="100%" align="left" style="width:50px;"|  '''Notes:'''{{refbegin}}{{note|lewis exile|1}} At the marooning, the castaways were informed to unanimously select on person who would be starting with them. Lewis was selected and sent to Exile Island until after the proceeding Tribal Council, joining the tribe that lost a member.<br />{{note|rob|2}} Rob elected to quit the game due to an injury. No vote occurred for his removal.<br />{{note|combined|3}} Combined Reward and Immunity Challenge.<br />{{note|tie|4}} The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Survivor'' rules, a revote would commence.<br />{{note|deadlock|5}} Per ''Survivor'' rules, in the event of a deadlock tie, the non-immune players would have an open discussion to eliminate one of the tied players. If no consensus is reached, the non-immune players will have to draw rocks, with the player who draws the odd-colored rock being eliminated.<br />{{note|kristin exile|6}} One person from the Journey was selected to be exiled until the next day.<br />{{refend}}
